description: This file defines a Java interface CustomerOptionValueDao which extends a generic DAO interface and declares methods for accessing CustomerOptionValue entities, specifically methods to list customer option values by store and language, and to get a customer option value by code.

classes.name: CustomerOptionValueDao
classes.description: A DAO interface for CustomerOptionValue entities, providing methods to query customer option values related to specific stores and languages.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Returns a list of CustomerOptionValue objects associated with a specific MerchantStore and Language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerOptionValue object for a specific store and option value code.
